name: THC subdomain and reverse-DNS database (ip.thc.org)
operator: The Hacker's Choice (THC), community security group
tier_rationale: Chair decision P016: only THC is community tier (and default) among the keyless passive subdomain feeds; well-known community security group with an identifiable operator and a public, documented free service (A8 community). No formal terms are published.

reliability.justification: Aggregated passive DNS/rDNS names with a last_seen_on date: a name was seen at some point, never proof that it exists or belongs to the organisation today (stale names are flagged).

subdomains.title: THC subdomain lookup API (POST /api/v1/lookup/subdomains, cursor paging, last_seen_on per name)

terms.quote: Registry terms per feed (A1 BR3): THC, AnubisDB and Subdomain Center are 'open' (legal_dpo: free services with no published terms, no contractual bar)

subdomains.notes: Quote: binding council text (P016 cond 4). The service answers 'Free Service!, Do not abuse' in every body. POST https://ip.thc.org/api/v1/lookup/subdomains {domain, limit, page_state} -> {comment, processed_domain, matching_records, domains[{domain, last_seen_on}], next_page_state} (research C0020, live 2026-11-26: example.com 20,766 records, cursor paging verified). x-ratelimit-limit 250 with an unknown window: the module stops paging when x-ratelimit-remaining runs out; 429 = rate limited (P016 cond 2).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-3 (P016, module subdomains_passive). Quota: x-ratelimit-limit 250 observed (window unknown) -> a soft day budget of 250 x 0.8 lookups (published false) plus 1 request/s; at most 10 pages per registrable domain (max_requests 10).
